cases.contract: An empty root string normalizes to an empty array
Trailing slashes are stripped from an absolute root
Surrounding whitespace is trimmed from an absolute root
Valid absolute directory paths survive normalization as a single root
A single escaping target is named in the cwd-boundary approval reason

Approve to allow this call, move the session with set_cwd if you will keep working there, or set tools.approvalMode: yolo to stop being asked at all.
